comment: The Haro v0.4 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.4 grows v0.3 by what a language declared OVER another language needs (haro/SPIKE.md, the fourth rung: harobanda's fleet file, whose every member names a machine FILE the fleet court reads, judges with the machine court, and reads through for the rules no single machine can fail): a SENTENCE seat type -- a seat whose value names a file of another declared language, read beside the judged file and judged by that language's own court; a VIEW -- a derived place by a closed rule (the one declaration of a set, named by a value or chosen by a condition); a condition whose places are PATHS (declaration.thing.kind, server.declaration.part), whose quantifiers run over a path or over the EARLIER declarations of a kind, whose comparisons take a place on either side, and `self is VIEW`; a FORMAT that FOLDs case; MESSAGES for a required seat absent; the shapes hex64 and hex64_lower. A fixture may carry `files` written beside it. Every v0.3 fixture still passes: v0.4 refuses nothing v0.3 accepted. Rejects carry the fragment the refusal must contain.

accepts.name: a SENTENCE is a seat type: the value names a file of another declared language (OF, read beside this declaration), with the words for a file that cannot be read and for one its court refuses
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE set AS (VERSION "0.4", GRAMMAR "0.4", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".set") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SENTENCE inner_file AS (OF "inner.haro", MESSAGE "MEMBER {name} names {value}, which cannot be read from beside this set file", REFUSED "MEMBER {name} is refused: {why} (line {line} of {value})") RATIONALE "a member is a file of the inner language"
DEFINE DECLARATION group AS (VERB "GROUP", SEATS [link: name?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION member AS (VERB "MEMBER", SEATS [declaration: inner_file, key: text?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD set AS (ONE [group], FIRST group) RATIONALE "x"

files.inner.haro:
DEFINE LANGUAGE inner AS (VERSION "0.4", GRAMMAR "0.4", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".inner") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU yes_no AS (WORDS [yes, no]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION thing AS (VERB "THING", SEATS [kind: name, mark: text?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION part AS (VERB "PART", SEATS [of: text, served: yes_no?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD inner AS (ONE [thing], FIRST thing) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a VIEW ON a declaration is a derived place: the ONE declaration of a set along a path, NAMED by a value or a place; it is read like a reference seat

accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE set AS (VERSION "0.4", GRAMMAR "0.4", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".set") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE SENTENCE inner_file AS (OF "inner.haro") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION group AS (VERB "GROUP", SEATS [link: name?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION member AS (VERB "MEMBER", SEATS [declaration: inner_file]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD set AS (ONE [group], FIRST group) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE VIEW link_part AS (ON member, ONE "declaration.part", NAMED "group.link") RATIONALE "x"

DEFINE CONSTRAINT somebody_serves AS (ON member, WHEN "link_part present and server absent", MESSAGE "{name} is on {group.link} and no member serves it") RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a FORMAT that FOLDs case compares case-blind (hex is); the shapes hex64 and hex64_lower; MESSAGES speaks for a required seat that is absent too
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE set AS (VERSION "0.4", GRAMMAR "0.4", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".set") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT key64 AS (SHAPE hex64, FOLD case, MESSAGE "KEY is 64 hex characters, and '{value}' is not one") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT head AS (SHAPE hex64_lower, MESSAGE "THROUGH is 64 lowercase hex, and '{value}' is not") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION group AS (VERB "GROUP", SEATS [link: name?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION member AS (VERB "MEMBER", SEATS [key: key64?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION retirement AS (VERB "RETIREMENT", SEATS [member: member, key: key64, through: head], MESSAGES [member: "RETIREMENT {name} retires a key of {value}, and no MEMBER {value} is declared", through: "RETIREMENT {name} names no THROUGH"]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE WORLD set AS (ONE [group], FIRST group) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT one_key_one_member AS (ON member, WHEN "key present and not key unique", MESSAGE "this key is already {other}'s key") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT retired_once AS (ON retirement, WHEN "earlier retirement where key = this.key", MESSAGE "this key is already retired as {other}") RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a v0.3 declaration is a v0.4 declaration: v0.3's A5, unchanged
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE m AS (VERSION "0.3", GRAMMAR "0.3", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".m") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU dhcp_only AS (WORDS [dhcp]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE MENU none_only AS (WORDS [none]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT address_prefix AS (SHAPE cidr) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORMAT wire_name AS (SHAPE label) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM word AS (SEATS [value: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM destination AS (SEATS [prefix: address_prefix]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION address AS (OF [dhcp_only, address_prefix]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE UNION egress AS (OF [none_only, [destination]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION network AS (VERB "NETWORK", SEATS [interface: text, address: address, egress: egress?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION peer AS (VERB "PEER", SEATS [network: network, address: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION service AS (VERB "SERVICE", SEATS [run: [word], after: [service]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION mount AS (VERB "MOUNT", SEATS [at: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION box AS (VERB "MACHINE", SEATS [identity: text?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT on_the_link AS (ON peer, WHEN "not address within network.address", MESSAGE "{address} is not on {network} ({network.address})") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT not_the_box AS (ON peer, WHEN "address host_of network.address", MESSAGE "{address} is the machine's own address on {network}") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT a_wire_name AS (ON peer, WHEN "not self matches wire_name", MESSAGE "'{name}' cannot be a name on the wire") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT no_cycle AS (ON service, WHEN "after cyclic", MESSAGE "AFTER forms a cycle through {name}: no order starts it") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT a_perimeter AS (ON network, WHEN "egress covers '0.0.0.0/0'", MESSAGE "EGRESS names a perimeter, and these destinations together cover every address there is") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT a_key_under_a_mount AS (ON box, WHEN "identity present and not identity under '/data'", MESSAGE "IDENTITY {identity} is not under /data") RATIONALE "x"
